verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents that it runs the official ClickHouse engine with the same SQL, and that every query works unchanged, so it inherits a native analytical SQL surface rather than relying on add-ons. However, the evidence never names window functions, CTEs, JSON, arrays, or date/time types, and the feature-status map notes some behaviors differ or are not implemented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of window functions, CTEs, semi-structured JSON, array types and functions, and rich date/time types, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of analytical query coverage.
